messages:
marta: Heads-up 1: we need a concise benchmark narrative for launch: hero "tilt" chart + small efficiency-frontier overlay + routing play. Draft deck by Fri, webinar in 2 weeks.

alex: Got it. I'll run microbench for chat (128/256), long-embed (1k) across hosted/dedicated/int8 and drop a compact CSV.

liv: Visual plan: 3 panel slide 1) hero tilt scatter (median vs $/1k) with shaded sweet-spot band, 2) tiny convex-hull frontier inset, 3) waterfall of per-token cost. Keep labels minimal.

sam: Webinar hook: why pick a point on the frontier, demo a micro-bench, engineering levers (routing, quant, batching), customer vignette, CTA for a free micro-bench. 20m + Qs.

noah: Inbound routing: bench-request -> tag "bench". ARR>25k -> AE alert. "private" or "VPC" -> Enterprise queue + security. If wants dedicated or >10k qps -> Solutions Eng.

bench-bot: microbench ready: median/p95/cost per 1k/tokens-s per GPU: hosted 135/420/$0.14/7k, dedicated 48/120/$0.075/30k, int8 68/180/$0.046/24k. CSV: /bench/microchat-2026-05/summary.csv

liv: Perfect 1 I'll mock PNGs overnight and put them in the deck. Copy idea: "Choose your speed-to-price spot" + CTA: "Run a free micro-bench".

marta: Solid. Action items: alex -> final CSV + a short p95 column (EOD). liv -> first PNGs (AM). sam -> webinar outline. noah -> RevOps rule doc. I'll assemble the deck and ping for one quick review. Thanks! :rocket:
